description: This PHP source file defines the 'EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao' class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for accessing and retrieving employee attendance data from the database. It includes methods to fetch recent attendance records, records within a date range, and open attendance entries for a specific employee.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class responsible for handling database operations related to employee attendance records, such as fetching latest, within a date range, or open attendance records.

methods.name: getLatestAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent attendance record for a specific employee by their employee number.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmployeeAndDate
methods.description: Fetches all attendance records for an employee within a specified date range, considering punch-in and punch-out times.

methods.name: getOpenAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an open attendance record (i.e., punched in but not punched out yet) for a given employee.
